column6: L·S on |m_l=0, m_s=+1/2⟩ was said to "produce a mixture"; it gives a single different state (ℏ²/√2)|m_l=1, m_s=−1/2⟩. Reworded to "returns a different state ... not an eigenstate".
Old text (not fixed): Core Idea writes L̂ᵧ where L̂_z is meant ("L̂ₓ, L̂ᵧ, L̂ᵧ", "typically L̂ᵧ", "Eigenvalues of L̂ᵧ are mℏ").
Old text fixed: q0 explanation said |ψ₁s|² peaks near a₀, contradicting the new bullet; changed to radial probability r²|R₁₀|² peaks at a₀.

Compared the local floor (computed over all random settings, 5/9) with the quantum rate "for settings 120° apart" (1/4 for unequal settings), a mismatched comparison. Now states 5/9 vs quantum 1/2 for three settings 120° apart (Mermin). Old Core Idea overstates: "settles the foundational debate about completeness".
Misassigned roles: "locality lets each row exist". Realism (preset values) makes the row exist; locality lets one A value serve in both AB and AB′. Reworded.

Old text (not fixed): q3 explanation claims all higher-order Born terms vanish for Coulomb (they diverge; exact result matches Rutherford only up to a phase) and calls Rutherford's 1911 result a triumph of quantum scattering theory.

Bullet 3 cited Lz in the Stark effect as an operator with distinct eigenvalues that fixes the good states; in n = 2, 2s and 2p(m=0) share m = 0, so Lz only reduces to a 2×2 block (as the How section itself says). Reworded.
Swap particles 1 and 2 and check that every term flips sign: individual terms do not flip; each maps to another term of opposite sign, so the whole determinant flips. Reworded.
Ehrenfest bullet dropped a qualifier: equality with the classical force is exact for at-most-quadratic potentials but only approximate for narrow wavepackets. Added "exactly"/"approximately".
At finite temperature μ shifts slightly is unconditional; the shift is large when k_BT ~ E_F (a case the How section plots). Now "moves away from E_F, though only slightly when k_BT ≪ E_F".
